dct_title_s: Western Sahara: Population Density for 400m H3 Hexagons
dct_description_sm: Western Sahara population density for 400m H3 hexagons. Built from [Kontur Population: Global Population Density for 400m H3 Hexagons](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/kontur-population-dataset) Vector H3 hexagons with population counts at 400m resolution. Fixed up fusion of [GHSL](https://ghsl.jrc.ec.europa.eu), [Facebook](https://research.facebook.com/downloads/high-resolution-settlement-layer-hrsl), [Microsoft Buildings](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/maps/building-footprints), [Copernicus Global Land Service Land Cover](https://land.copernicus.eu/global/products/lc), Land Information New Zealand ([LINZ Data Service](https://data.linz.govt.nz)) NZ Building Outlines and [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org) data. Gobal version of population dataset: [Kontur Population: Global Population Density for 400m H3 Hexagons](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/kontur-population-dataset)
